title: Restart instructions overstate when a TermAl MCP server can pick up a new build
outcome: Restart instructions overstate when a TermAl MCP server can pick up a new build
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md accurately distinguish recreation of an agent runtime or session from a full TermAl restart when describing how a fresh Engram MCP server loads the configured installed build, without granting agents a new restart or configuration act.
